Ref. E.4(5)  29th May 1942.

Dear Stewart Roberts,

The Aliens Protected Area Certificate of Mr. H. von RAUSCHENPLAT has been cancelled as requested also his A.W.S. permit.

His Registration Certificate is returned herewith.

Yours sincerely,

[signature]

W. Stewart Roberts, Esq.,
Box No. 2.
Western Central District Post Office,
New Oxford Street, W.C.1.
